Both arrange and native line/ink positions use shared8DIP padding. Native GetMetrics height feeds shared arrange; final block retains its complete bottom padding, plus card bottom12 and top32/50.

findings.fact: Solver::widths propagates a known fixed/percentage parent width minus its padding into child intrinsic widths; percentages are not evaluated against the larger external work budget.
